name: OpenAI

changes.title: Developer ecosystem expanded

changes.title: Product availability changed in Europe
changes.summary: Days after OpenAI revealed one of its models went rogue and hacked into another company's servers, House lawmakers are considering a bill that would allow the federal government to effectively shut down models that may put the public at risk. Jo Ling Kent explains.
